description: h09 (DOAS with DCV, 0.80/0.80 wheel, variable-volume relief fan; radiant ceiling on the ventilation schedule) with the 16 C radiant loop designed for a 5 K temperature difference instead of 4 K.
design_intent: Reduce terminal pumping at unchanged head: 20% less radiant-loop design flow. Risk: a warmer mean panel water temperature lowers panel output per m2, which could raise the PMV hot share (h09: 6.8%, comfort 92.1%).

air_process_design.load_basis: h09 simulated: July hour zone 27.9 C / 11.4 g/kg, panel surface 23.5 C, supply 15.2 C / 8.7 g/kg; January hour zone 27.7 C / 9.5 g/kg. A 5 K loop difference raises the mean water temperature by about 0.5 K at design flow; the variable-flow panels compensate with flow at part load.

cooling.process_notes: Outdoor 27.2 C / 21.8 g/kg -> wheel at 0.80/0.80 against 27.9 C / 11.4 g/kg exhaust -> 27.8 C / 13.5 g/kg -> DOAS coil to 12 C -> fan +3.2 K -> zone; radiant panels at about 23.5 C surface.

heating.process_notes: Winter ventilation: wheel bypassed (outdoor enthalpy below exhaust), coil cools sensibly to 12 C, fan +3.2 K; zone floats below the 26 C operative setpoint on internal gains.

engineering_basis: Catalog radiant series and air-side options unchanged. Script: relief fan type constant volume -> variable volume at the relief fan's own pressure rise (the baseline relief pressure), total efficiency 0.55 and motor efficiency 0.92, with the toolkit variable-volume power coefficients; disabled DOAS heating coil water flow set to zero.

tool_plan.strategy_summary: DOAS (DCV, 0.80/0.80 enthalpy wheel with bypass) + radiant ceiling on a 16 C low-lift water-cooled chiller + 7 C water-cooled DOAS chiller, no heating; radiant terminals available only during the ventilation schedule. Radiant loop design temperature difference 5 K.

args.engineering_justification: Catalog values unchanged: BEC 2024 Table 6.12b water-cooled chiller COP 5.5 at 7/32 C; low-lift terminal chiller credited +3.5%/K to 16 C (project literature rule) = 7.2325; fan and pump pressures inherit the active baseline; heat recovery 0.80/0.80 within the 0.80 limit.
args.notes: h09 arguments with the radiant terminal loop at 16/21 C (design temperature difference 5 K instead of 4 K).
args.hvac_availability_schedule_name: ventilation schedule of the baseline model

tool_plan.engineering_basis: Same equipment and catalog parameters as rad_water_water_no_heat with air-side options (h06/h08). Only the terminal availability schedule is set through the toolkit argument hvac_availability_schedule_name; BEC 2024 chiller COP minimum, 8 L/s per person outdoor air with DCV, exhaust-air energy recovery.
tool_plan.rationale: h09 equipment energy: pumps 7.78 kWh/m2 at the fixed baseline head, so pump energy can only fall through flow. The radiant loop design difference of 4 K is below the 5 K the plant rule allows for high-temperature loops; 5 K cuts the design flow of the terminal pump by 20% and, through the chiller's evaporator flow, nothing else. Panel surface temperature rises slightly at the return end. Requested case_id=h10.
